Strict Child Safeguarding Policy and Code of Conduct
safety.policy_summary: ICS maintains a comprehensive Child Safeguarding and Protection Policy aligned with international expectations (ITFCP and ICMEC). The policy applies to all staff, volunteers, and visitors, establishing a three-tier governance and response structure including a Designated Safeguarding Lead (DSL) and a Safeguarding Response Team to ensure child safety takes precedence.
